item.description: LOTTO RESULT JANUARY 9, 2026 – The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announces the complete lotto results for Friday, January 9, 2026 at 2PM, 5PM, and 9PM draws. These include the Mega Lotto 6/45, Ultra Lotto 6/58, EZ2 (2D Lotto), Swertres (3D lotto), and 4D Lotto. The jackpot prizes for the major draws 6/45 and 6/58 now stand at Php 11.2 million and Php 218.3 million, respectively.
